text:
Maya: Quick sync — thinking about adding an adaptive hysteresis layer to dedicated GPU pool scaling so we don't oscillate on short bursts while still meeting SLA bands. thoughts?
Jake: +1 on hysteresis. need to define windows and signal sources.
Paul: Can you sketch the signals? is it just queue length + recent latency SLO breaches?
Maya: Primary signals: inflight token rate, tail latency SLO breaches (p99 p50), and a cost-swing metric from billing pipeline. Secondary: prewarm credit balance, tenant priority score.
Tina: Concern: coupling cost metric into autoscaler can delay capacity for high-priority tenants during cost spikes. maybe keep cost as advisory not gating.
Maya: Agreed — propose 2-tier policy: safety-first SLO band (hard) that immediately triggers scale-up; cost-adaptive band (soft) that nudges decisions when SLOs ok.
Zoe: How would rollbacks/fallback work if prewarmed nodes fail to attach? we need a graceful fallback to smaller model variants or region reroute.
Jake: We already have fallback routes in the runtime. Autoscaler should publish an intent object with a fallback list. operator picks cheapest compatible variant.
Maya: Implementation notes: add hysteresis window param per-pool: {min_hold_secs, cool_down_secs, scale_granularity}. default 120s hold, 300s cooldown, granular by GPU counts.
Paul: Also want soft-reservation tokens for tenants: keep X tokens reserved that don't count against burst credits. helps critical workloads.
Tina: Eviction tradeoff: when we drain GPUs to scale down, we should prefer preemptible/ephemeral slots first, then best-effort. avoid evicting pinned dedicated tenants except last resort.
Jake: Agreed. Add an eviction scoring function: (pinned? high_penalty) + (sla_violation_risk) + (idle_time) + (prewarm_credit_usage). lower score evicted first.
Maya: For testing, can we simulate a 10x short spike (30s) vs a sustained 10m spike and verify no oscillation and SLOs remain under thresholds?
Zoe: I'll produce a synthetic workload harness. can we add a config flag to switch hysteresis off to compare?
Maya: yes — feature flag + per-pool override. We should also emit telemetry: decision_reason, input_signals, predicted_cost_delta.
infra-bot: deploy-plan created: "hysteresis-proto-v1" -> staged to canary cluster. runbook: rollback if p99 latency > 1.5x baseline for >5m.
Paul: One more: operator UX — expose an "aggressiveness" knob: conservative / balanced / aggressive mapping to hold/cooldown/granularity. product needs this for Dedicated customers.
Tina: And document: recommended profiles by workload (chat low-latency, batch embeddings tolerant).
Maya: I'll draft a short RFC with proto shapes for the intent object, eviction scoring, and telemetry fields. can everyone review tomorrow?
Jake: LGTM, will add notes about cost-as-advisory and how it integrates with billing signals.
Zoe: I'll queue the harness and attach load traces.
Maya: thanks all :thumbsup:
